symptom: `call microflow … in queue Q retry exponential (…)` was a syntax error, and a create or modify of a flow whose queued call had a Studio Pro retry was refused, so the flow was locked for MDL
cause: Queues$QueueFixedRetry / Queues$QueueExponentialRetry had no grammar, AST, writer or describe; the reader kept Retry as opaque raw
insight: Two measurements decided it. (1) A control that does NOT discriminate: writing IntervalType 'Days' still gave mx check 0 errors, so a clean check proved nothing about whether mx reads Retry at all; Retries: 0 gave CE7044 'Retries should be at least 1.' on the call — the control that does, and a rule for the visitor. (2) Making a stored property authorable changes what the splice path sees: on main a script restating the call without the retry was 'Unchanged' (retry invisible, so equal), after the change it became an in-place edit that silently dropped the retry, because checkNoQueuedCalls only runs on the rebuild path. Any guard written for the rebuild path must also run before modifyFlowInPlace once its property enters the compared model. Build the 'main' control binary in a git worktree: git stash leaves new untracked files behind and the build of 'main' then fails or, worse, builds the branch.
